item.title: INDECOM probing triple fatal shooting in St.James

item.title: CARICOM to respond to humanitarian crisis in Cuba within a month
item.description: The Caribbean Community (CARICOM) says it will respond to help address the growing humanitarian crisis in Cuba. The United States of America (U.S.A.) had implemented measures to cut off Cuba's oil supply, which has affected other key sectors in that island such as healthcare.
